author: Perry Krug
content:
Son’s birthday party over the weekend. Ordered a bouncy castle from Dancing Cubs a few days before. The service and experience was exceptional. Ordered on the website, quick confirmation email, check ins along the way an absolutely STELLAR delivery/setup/pickup service by Said. He was prompt, friendly, flexible and even let my 4yr old “help” put the castle away at the end of the day.

Highly recommend, in fact I already did!
